faq_heading: Homes near Kwantlen Park Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Kwantlen Park Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Kwantlen Park Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Kwantlen Park Secondary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Kwantlen Park Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 695 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,100,000, townhomes $724,900, condos $411,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Kwantlen Park Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Kwantlen Park Secondary the median was 31 days on the market, closing at 96.3% of the list price, with 6% of sales above the list price for the 695 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Kwantlen Park Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are K B Woodward Elementary (0.4 km north-west), Old Yale Road Elementary (0.6 km south) and Theresa Clarke Elementary (0.9 km north).

The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Kwantlen Park Secondary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 2 km of the school.
How the Kwantlen Park Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Kwantlen Park Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Kwantlen Park Secondary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 695 homes sold within 2 km of Kwantlen Park Secondary: 97 houses, 47 townhomes and 544 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $411,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Kwantlen Park Secondary

28 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Kwantlen Park Secondary in a straight line (21 elementary, 7 secondary; 4 independent). The closest is K B Woodward Elementary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Guildford Park Secondary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Honour Secondary School (1.0 km); the nearest independent school is Honour Secondary School (1.0 km). Other secondary schools close by: Honour Secondary School (1.0 km east), Khalsa Secondary School (Surrey) (1.6 km west), Queen Elizabeth Secondary (2.1 km south), L.A. Matheson Secondary (2.8 km south-west), North Surrey Learning Centre (2.8 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Khalsa Secondary School (Surrey), 1.6 km west of Kwantlen Park Secondary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Kwantlen Park Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Kwantlen Park Secondary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Kwantlen Park Secondary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median condo within 2 km of Kwantlen Park Secondary was $411,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Honour Secondary School, the nearest other secondary school, 1.0 km east of Kwantlen Park Secondary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
